themeDescription: How to ask good questions (to AI and to ourselves)

days.title: The Power of Questions - Unlocking Understanding
days.learning_objective: Recognize that questions are more powerful than answers—they unlock curiosity, drive discovery, and create genuine understanding.

days.title: Types of Questions - Open vs Closed, Deep vs Shallow
days.learning_objective: Distinguish between different types of questions and understand when to use open-ended versus closed questions for different purposes.

days.title: Asking AI - How to Get Useful Answers
days.learning_objective: Learn effective prompting strategies to get clear, helpful, and accurate responses from AI systems.

days.title: Asking Experts - Learning from People Who Know More
days.learning_objective: Develop skills for respectfully and effectively seeking knowledge from teachers, mentors, and subject matter experts.

days.title: Asking Yourself - The Art of Self-Reflection
days.learning_objective: Practice self-reflection through powerful questions that reveal values, goals, and areas for growth.

days.title: The Socratic Method - Questions That Lead to Discovery
days.learning_objective: Understand how guided questioning can lead to deeper understanding than direct answers, using the Socratic method.

days.title: Why Questions - Understanding Purpose and Motivation
days.learning_objective: Master the 'why' question to uncover root causes, motivations, and the deeper meaning behind facts and events.

days.title: How Questions - Understanding Process and Method
days.learning_objective: Use 'how' questions to understand processes, methods, and the steps that lead from beginning to end.

days.title: What If Questions - Imagination and Possibility
days.learning_objective: Employ 'what if' questions to explore possibilities, spark creativity, and imagine alternative scenarios.

days.title: Follow-Up Questions - Going Deeper
days.learning_objective: Develop the habit of asking follow-up questions to dig deeper beyond surface-level answers.

days.title: Clarifying Questions - Making Sure You Understand
days.learning_objective: Use clarifying questions to ensure you've correctly understood information before acting on it.

days.title: Challenging Questions - Questioning Assumptions
days.learning_objective: Practice questioning assumptions—both your own and others'—to test the foundations of beliefs and claims.

days.title: Context Matters - Same Question, Different Answers
days.learning_objective: Understand that context shapes meaning, and the same question can have different correct answers in different situations.

days.title: Specificity Helps - Vague Questions, Vague Answers
days.learning_objective: Learn that specific, precise questions lead to more useful and actionable answers than vague ones.

days.title: Breaking Down Big Questions - Complex Problems into Simple Parts
days.learning_objective: Master the skill of decomposing large, complex questions into smaller, manageable sub-questions.

days.title: Building Up from Answers - Answers That Lead to More Questions
days.learning_objective: Recognize that good answers often generate new questions, creating a positive cycle of learning.

days.title: Questions That Connect - Finding Relationships
days.learning_objective: Use questions to discover connections between different ideas, subjects, and areas of knowledge.

days.title: Questions That Divide - Distinguishing Differences
days.learning_objective: Ask questions that help distinguish between similar concepts and identify important differences.

days.title: Honest Questions - Asking When You Genuinely Don't Know
days.learning_objective: Embrace intellectual humility by asking genuine questions from a place of curiosity rather than pretense.

days.title: Pretend Questions - Asking to Show Off vs to Learn
days.learning_objective: Distinguish between questions asked for genuine learning versus those asked to impress, and focus on authentic inquiry.

days.title: Brave Questions - Asking When You're Afraid To
days.learning_objective: Build courage to ask difficult or uncomfortable questions that lead to important understanding.

days.title: Silly Questions - There Are No Dumb Questions
days.learning_objective: Overcome the fear of asking 'silly' questions by recognizing that curiosity at any level is valuable.

days.title: Big Questions - The Questions That Change Everything
days.learning_objective: Explore the big questions—about existence, meaning, and purpose—that shape how we understand life.

days.title: Little Questions - The Details That Matter
days.learning_objective: Appreciate how small, specific questions about details can reveal important insights.

days.title: Unanswerable Questions - Learning to Sit with Uncertainty
days.learning_objective: Develop comfort with questions that may not have definitive answers, embracing uncertainty as part of learning.

days.title: Questions for AI - Best Practices for AI Prompting
days.learning_objective: Master effective AI prompting techniques including context-setting, specificity, and iteration.

days.title: Questions AI Can't Answer - Knowing AI's Limits
days.learning_objective: Understand which types of questions AI cannot reliably answer—personal values, future predictions, subjective experiences.

days.title: Month in Review - The Art of Questioning
days.learning_objective: Synthesize the month's learning into a personal questioning practice that enhances all future learning.
